properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 19 at 10:44AM CDT until August 19 at 11:15AM CDT by NWS North Platte NE
properties.description:
At 1044 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Bartlett to near Ericson to 7 miles east of Fort
Hartsuff State Park, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

These severe storms will be near...
Ericson around 1050 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include
Cumminsville, Four Corners, and Pibel Lake State Recreation Area.

This includes Highway 281 between mile markers 132 and 149.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 19 at 10:44AM EDT until August 23 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Indiana...

East Fork White River near Rivervale.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...

East Fork White River at Seymour.

.Heavy to extreme rainfall over east-central Indiana since last week
has led to minor flooding on the East Fork White River in Jackson
County down to Rivervale. Flooding will end at Seymour later this
afternoon...with the crest reaching Rivervale Thursday evening.
Rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches over the basin through Friday
morning were included in this forecast, so higher amounts would
increase crests and potentially bring additional flooding.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...East Fork White River near Rivervale.

* WHEN...Until early Sunday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 22.0 feet, A few local county roads begin to flood
and are impassable. These include Buddha Road south of the gage
and Lawrenceport Road. All local roads across the East Fork White
River are threatened by high water, and some are closed. Flooding
of agricultural lands in Lawrence County is in progress.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 20.7 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 9:30 AM EDT Wednesday was 20.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 21.5
feet tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage
early Sunday morning.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
